en: In this time of reckoning, Vigil calls forth a new generation of heroes. The untested must rise, guided by legends of old and the light of those who sacrificed before them. Against the Muses’ vision of unending chaos, the champions of today must forge their own legendary paths. The world awaits, and only through strength, courage, and unity can Vigil transcend this dark design. Your deeds are known, your valor witnessed, and through fire and flame, you must stand the test to become a legend—the future rests upon your ascension.
zh: 在此清算之时，祈夜召唤新一代英雄。未经考验者必须挺身而出，以先贤传说与前人牺牲之光为指引。面对缪斯无尽混沌的异象，今日的勇士必须开辟属于自己的传奇之路。世界在等待——唯有凭力量、勇气与团结，祈夜才能超越这黑暗的设计。你的功绩人尽皆知，你的勇武有目共睹；历经烈火试炼，你必须成为传奇——未来系于你的登升。

en: As there is an element of divine inspiration in every act of creation, so too are there patrons for the arts of slaughter and destruction. For centuries, the Red Sisters have whispered their poisonous inspirations to the champions of destruction—Samael, Kythis, Xeron—fueling strife in the hearts of mortals and gods alike. They have watched as Vigil waged war after war, each act of defiance feeding their art of carnage. Now the Muses seek a final creation, one to remake Vigil from its very bones, a monument to the darkness they have nurtured across the ages.
zh: 正如每一次创世都含有神启的火花，杀戮与毁灭的技艺也有其庇护者。数世纪以来，红姐妹向毁灭的勇士——萨麦尔、凯西斯、泽伦——低语有毒的灵感，在凡人与神明心中煽动纷争。她们注视祈夜一战再战，每一次反抗都滋养她们的屠戮艺术。如今缪斯寻求最终之作：从骨架重塑祈夜，为自己历经诸纪哺育的黑暗立起丰碑。

en: Eons have passed since Vigil’s heroes first defended their world against Samael, the Fallen God. Though the Godslayer’s victory brought peace, each hard-won era has been followed by threats even more harrowing. Vigil has birthed heroes to stand against every nightmare, but with each victory, darkness has gathered anew. Now, in the sulfurous depths of Deoful, something ancient stirs—the Red Sisters—the Muses of Malevolence. These shadowy patrons of slaughter and ruin stand poised to weave their own dreadful masterpiece.
zh: 自祈夜英雄首次抵御堕落之神萨麦尔以来，已过去无数纪元。虽弑神者的胜利带来和平，每一段来之不易的时代之后，威胁却更加骇人。祈夜不断诞下英雄对抗每场梦魇，但每场胜利之后，黑暗又再度聚集。如今，在迪奥弗硫磺深处，古老之物苏醒——红姐妹，恶意缪斯。这些屠杀与毁灭的阴影庇护者，正准备编织她们可怖的杰作。

en: Many cards in Ascension: Legends™ have a Renown Threshold Effect—an extra ability that activates when you play the card, provided you’ve reached the required space on the Legendary Track for that faction.
zh: <margin-right=12em>《创升纪元：史诗传奇》中许多卡牌具有声望阈值效果——额外异能：当你打出该牌时，若你在该派系的传奇轨道上已到达所需格位，则触发该效果。

en: When you reach the 12th space on any faction’s path of the Legendary Track, you become a legend within that faction. From that turn onward, you may acquire or defeat 1 card from the Center Row belonging to that faction for free each turn. As with Boons, you can activate this ability at any time during your turn.
zh: 当你在传奇轨道任一派系路径上到达第12格时，你成为该派系中的传奇。从该回合起，每回合你可以免费从中央牌列获取或击败1张属于该派系的卡牌。与恩赐一样，你可以在自己回合中的任何时候启动此能力。

en: Each Boon’s effect is written on its Legendary Character card and is unique to that Legend. When you earn a Boon, you may use it at any point during your turn before it ends. This allows you to keep acquiring Heroes and Constructs, advancing on the Legendary Track, or defeating Monsters before activating the Boon for maximum impact. However, unused Boons expire at the end of the turn.
zh: 每份恩赐的效果写在其传奇角色卡上，且对该传奇独一无二。当你获得恩赐时，可在本回合结束前的任意时刻使用。这样你可以继续获取英雄与神器、在传奇轨道上推进，或击败怪物，再启动恩赐以发挥最大效果。未使用的恩赐会在回合结束时失效。

en: <margin-right=12em>In Ascension: Legends™, acquiring or defeating cards in the Center Row earns you Renown (<sprite=172>) with each faction shown on that card. Renown represents your rising status as a legend. Each point you gain moves you one space up the Legendary Track for the corresponding faction(s).
zh: <margin-right=12em>在《创升纪元：史诗传奇》中，获取或击败中央牌列的卡牌会为该牌所示的每个派系赢得声望（<sprite=172>）。声望代表你作为传奇的地位上升。你获得的每一点声望，会使你在对应派系的传奇轨道上前进一格。

en:
At the heart of Ascension: Legends™ is the Legendary Track, where you’ll compete to earn Renown () alongside some of the most iconic characters in the Ascension™ universe.

As you play, you’ll advance along this track, unlocking special abilities, known as Boons, granted by the Legends overseeing your game.

Reach the end of the track, and you’ll secure your place as a legend within one of the four factions, gaining the ability to acquire or defeat a card of that faction for free at the start of each turn.
zh:
《创升纪元：史诗传奇》的核心是传奇轨道：你将与创升纪元宇宙中最具代表性的角色并肩，争夺声望（）。

对局过程中，你会沿轨道前进，解锁由主持本局的传奇授予的特殊能力——恩赐。

到达轨道尽头后，你将成为四派系之一中的传奇，并获得能力：每回合开始时免费获取或击败一张该派系卡牌。

en: Each Legendary Character comes from one of the four factions in Ascension™ and is loyal to that faction. To win their favor, you’ll need to show your allegiance by acquiring or defeating cards from their faction to earn Renown (<sprite=172>). Earn enough Renown with a faction, and you’ll unlock the Boon granted by that faction’s Legendary Character.
zh: 每位传奇角色来自创升纪元四派系之一，并忠于该派系。要赢得其青睐，你需通过获取或击败其派系卡牌来展示效忠，从而获得声望（<sprite=172>）。在某一派系累积足够声望后，你将解锁该派系传奇角色授予的恩赐。

en: The threat posed by the Muses of Malevolence is one of the greatest Vigil has ever faced, but in its time of need, the champions of Vigil’s past have answered the call to battle. Former Heroes turned Legends, the Legendary Characters selected at the start of each game wait only for a worthy Hero to appear before lending their power to the struggle against the Red Sisters.
zh: 恶意缪斯带来的威胁，是祈夜有史以来最严峻的之一；但在危难之时，往昔的勇士已应召参战。昔日英雄化作传奇——每局开始时选定的传奇角色，只待一位配得上的英雄出现，便会把力量借予对抗红姐妹的斗争。

en:
Long ago, the god Adayu lost his grip on reality, and in his madness, unraveled the realms of Vigil. Heroes from the four factions rose to save their shattered world, and from the ashes rose a new world, New Vigil.

Even after Adayu’s redemption, New Vigil remained littered with portals to previously unreachable worlds - a final gift from the mad god. One such world was the Dreamscape, a realm of dreams and nightmares, where no conscious being was ever meant to enter.

It wasn’t long before the factions of New Vigil found their way into the Dreamscape, and a war for dominance began. Thousands upon thousands died in that realm, a place death’s icy fingers had never touched, and the Dreamscape began to warp.

Pasythea, the Aegis, Guardian of the Dreamscape, witnessed the corruption of her realm and feared that a prolonged war would mean annihilation for conscious and unconscious beings alike.

Pasythea chose to banish the factions from her domain, forcing champion after champion back into the conscious world.  In her final moment, mortally wounded by Emri, Champion of the Void, The Aegis warded the gate to New Vigil, cutting off the Dreamscape forever.

Or so she thought.

It was in the Valley of the Ancients, hidden away in the forgotten jungles of the world, that explorers came upon a new gate to the Dreamscape. The foolhardy explorers opened the portal. They saw into the unconscious realm and learned the consequences of their ancestor’s meddling.

A broken Dreamscape, twisted by the war between the conscious and the unconscious, poured madness into the world. The corrupted energy infected the factions of New Vigil, manifesting their wildest dreams and darkest nightmares as unthinkable versions of their champions.

Now, the world is in a state of delirium, and the twisted heroes of New Vigil must rise to push back the tide of monsters and madness.
zh:
很久以前，神明阿达尤失去了对现实的掌控；在疯狂中，他解开了祈夜诸界。四派系的英雄奋起拯救破碎的世界，灰烬中升起新世界：新祈夜。

即便在阿达尤得赎之后，新祈夜仍布满通往往昔不可及世界的传送门——那是疯神留下的最后礼物。其一便是梦境：梦与梦魇之界，本不应有清醒生命踏入。

不久，新祈夜各派系找到进入梦境之路，争夺主宰的战争爆发。成千上万死于那片连死亡冰指也未曾触碰之地，梦境开始扭曲。

梦境守卫、神盾帕西提亚目睹领域腐化，唯恐久战将令清醒与沉睡的生灵同归于尽。

帕西提亚选择将各派系逐出其域，一任冠军又一位冠军被赶回清醒世界。在她最后时刻，被虚空冠军艾姆瑞重创的神盾守护通往新祈夜的门，将梦境永久隔绝。

至少她如此以为。

在上古山谷——隐于被遗忘丛林深处——探险者发现了通往梦境的新门。鲁莽的探险者打开了传送门。他们窥见无意识领域，也得知祖先干涉的后果。

被清醒与无意识之战扭曲的破碎梦境，将疯狂倾注入世。腐化能量感染新祈夜各派，把最狂妄的梦与最黑暗的梦魇化为不可思议的冠军变体。

如今世界陷入谵妄，新祈夜被扭曲的英雄必须挺身击退怪物与疯狂之潮。

en: The Delirium Die is a special Ascension 6-sided die that can be rolled to gain different effects. During a player’s turn, that player may spend <sprite=117> to roll the Delirium Die. When the die is rolled, the player gains whatever effect is listed on the side facing up.
zh: 谵妄骰是一枚特殊的创升纪元六面骰，掷出可获得不同效果。在玩家回合中，该玩家可花费 <sprite=117> 掷谵妄骰。骰子停下后，玩家获得朝上那一面所列的效果。

en: <margin-right=12em>When a card with Fate Aution enters the center row, players may bid <sprite=112> to gain the effect listed underneath the Fate text. Starting with the active player and moving clockwise, each player may bid <sprite=112>. To bid, a player must bid at least <sprite=113>, must bid higher than the current bid and cannot bid more <sprite=112> than they have. If a player chooses not to bid or can’t bid, that player is out. Players continue making bids until one person is left in the running. The player that wins the Auction must pay <sprite=112> equal to their winning bid and copies the effect of the Auction card immediately.
zh: <margin-right=12em>当带有天命拍卖的卡牌进入中央牌列时，玩家可出价 <sprite=112> 以获得天命文字下方所列效果。从当前玩家起顺时针，每位玩家可出价 <sprite=112>。出价至少须为 <sprite=113>，必须高于当前出价，且不能超过自己拥有的 <sprite=112>。若玩家选择不出价或无法出价，则退出。玩家继续出价，直到只剩一人。拍卖胜者须支付与其胜出出价等量的 <sprite=112>，并立即复制该拍卖牌的效果。

en:
The Dreamscape was sealed, locked away by the champions of New Vigil, and protected by its defender: Pasetheya, the Aegis.

But no doors stay locked forever.

It was in the Valley of the Ancients, in the forgotten jungles of the world, that explorers came upon a new gate to the Dreamscape; a portal manifest during the years of Adayu’s madness.

Despite the warnings, they broke open the portal and could only watch as all the horrors of the unconscious realm flooded into their world in a tidal wave of delirium.

Emri, Dhartha, Kor, and Cetra, the immortal champions of New Vigil, fought desperately to close the gate, but in the end, they found themselves among the first of the Dreamscape’s victims, warped by its power.

The energy seeped into the ground, infected the plants and animals, and changed the nature of all things. New and terrifying monsters sprung up, bringing death, madness, and chaos to the people of every faction.

But from the chaos, new heroes rose up, different from the champions of old. These heroes did not reject the dreamscape energy; they embraced it. Learning to wield it as weapons, channel it as magic, and harness it as fuel for their machines.

This is the final push to free the land from madness once and for all. As New Vigil dissolves into a state of delirium, you must lead the champions of the old world and the heroes of the new to call forth Pasythea, the protector of the Dreamscape, to seal the gate and stabilize the world.

New Vigil’s deliverance is in your hands!
zh:
梦境曾被新祈夜的冠军封闭，并由其守护者神盾帕西提亚守护。

但没有门能永远锁住。

正是在上古山谷、被遗忘的丛林中，探险者发现了通往梦境的新门——阿达尤疯狂岁月中显现的传送门。

不顾警告，他们强行打开门户，只能眼看着无意识领域的一切恐怖如谵妄潮水涌入其世界。

艾姆瑞、达尔塔、科尔与塞特拉——新祈夜的不朽冠军——拼死试图关闭门户，最终却成为梦境最早的受害者，被其力量扭曲。

能量渗入土地，感染动植物，改变万物本性。新而可怖的怪物涌现，给各派人民带来死亡、疯狂与混乱。

但混乱中也升起新英雄，不同于往日冠军。他们不拒梦境能量，反而拥抱它：当作武器、当作魔法、当作机械的燃料。

这是将土地从疯狂中永久解放的最后一击。当新祈夜溶解于谵妄，你必须率领旧世界的冠军与新世界的英雄，唤来梦境守护者帕西提亚，封闭门户并稳定世界。

新祈夜的救赎，握在你手中！

en:
Insight () is gained through card effects and Dreamborn cards (see below). Unlike most other resources, you do not lose unspent Insight at the end of your turn.

In Ascension: Deliverance™, players start with different amounts of . The player who goes first starts with . The player who goes second starts with , third starts with and fourth starts with .
zh:
洞察（）通过卡牌效果与梦生卡获得（见下文）。与大多数资源不同，未花费的洞察在回合结束时不会失去。

在《创升纪元：救赎》™中，玩家开局拥有的 数量不同。先手玩家从 开始；第二位从 开始，第三位从 开始，第四位从 开始。

en:
For the first time since most of its inhabitants can remember, New Vigil is at peace. Rallied by their champions, the four factions drove the Cult of Deofol back into the shadows. This time of prosperity gave way to a cultural and intellectual renaissance that had never been seen before.

Free to once again pursue their own passions, the monks and seers began to catch glimpses of a new realm, seemingly always at the edge of their perception, like a mirage shimmering just beyond the edges of reality. Dismissed as merely visions at first, the shared experiences soon revealed that this was something more, a pocket of creation left behind in the wake of Adayu’s ascendancy. 

This Dreamscape, as the first visitors referred to it, reflected the possibilities and impossibilities that awaited New Vigil and the people that inhabited it, but where there are dreams, there are also nightmares. 

As more people gained access to the dream world, they brought with them their own goals and desires, for better or worse. Seeing the potential for abuse of the new power, the factions chose Pasythea, an Askaran warrior, to serve as the Dreamscape’s guardian in the event that it should need one.

Now, as the factions gain new insight into the possibilities that await them in the Dreamscape, they must also be on guard for those who might abuse the power for their own nefarious ends. Join them in a world of infinite possibilities as they explore the glorious future that awaits New Vigil.
zh:
自大多数居民记事以来，新祈夜首次迎来和平。在冠军号召下，四派系将迪奥弗教团逼回阴影。繁荣催生前所未见的文化与智识复兴。

得以再追热情的僧侣与先知，开始瞥见一个新领域——似乎总在感知边缘，如现实之外颤动的蜃景。起初被视为异象，共享体验很快表明这不止如此：那是阿达尤登升余波中留下的创世残片。

最早造访者称之为梦境，它映照新祈夜及其住民的可能与不可能；有梦便有梦魇。

越来越多人进入梦界，也带入各自目标与欲望，或好或坏。见新力量可能被滥用，各派系选择亚哈战士帕西提亚，在需要时担任梦境守卫。

如今，当各派系洞见梦境中等待的可能时，也须提防为一己私利滥用力量之人。加入他们，在无限可能的世界中，探索新祈夜辉煌的未来。

en: <margin-right=12em>Visions are a new card type found in the Dream deck in Ascension: Dreamscape™. When a Vision is acquired from a player’s Dreamscape, it isn’t added to that player’s deck. Instead, the card has an immediate effect on the game. Resolve the effect on the card, then banish it unless it has an Ongoing effect. Visions with Ongoing effects stay face up in front of the player. That effect is considered to be in play for the rest of the game.
zh: <margin-right=12em>异象是《创升纪元：梦境》™梦境牌库中的新卡牌类型。当玩家从自己的梦境获取异象时，它不会加入该玩家牌库。相反，该牌立即对对局产生效果。结算其效果后将其放逐，除非它具有持续效果。具有持续效果的异象正面朝上留在玩家面前，该效果视为在余下对局中生效。

en:
<margin-right=12em>The biggest new feature in Ascension: Dreamscape™ is the Dreamscape–a hidden set of cards players have access to during the game. Unlike center row cards, each player’s Dreamscape cards are purchasable only by that player. These cards are purchasable during the game with a new resource called Insight (<sprite=112>).

At the beginning of the game, each player is dealt five Dream cards from the Dream deck, from which they will choose three that they then add to their personal Dreamscape. The two remaining unchosen cards should be kept hidden from the other players and are shuffled back into the Dream deck. Set the Dream deck aside for easy access during the game.

The Dream deck includes Heroes, Constructs, and Visions.  In addition to unique frames, Dream cards can also be identified by their  gold borders.

<margin=0>Each player has their own Dreamscape that should be placed face down in front of them. Players may look at the cards in their Dreamscape at any time, but it should be kept hidden from everyone else. Players may purchase cards from their own Dreamscape during their turn at any time they could normally acquire cards from the center row.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>《创升纪元：梦境》™最大的新内容是梦境——对局中玩家可使用的一组隐藏卡牌。与中央牌列不同，每位玩家的梦境卡只能由该玩家购买。这些卡在对局中用新资源洞察（<sprite=112>）购买。

对局开始时，每位玩家从梦境牌库发五张梦境卡，从中选择三张加入个人梦境。其余两张须对其他玩家保密，并洗回梦境牌库。将梦境牌库放在一旁以便取用。

梦境牌库包含英雄、神器与异象。除独特卡框外，梦境卡也可凭金色边框辨认。

<margin=0>每位玩家有自己的梦境，应正面朝下置于面前。玩家可随时查看自己梦境中的卡牌，但须对其他人保密。玩家可在自己回合中、本可从中央牌列获取卡牌的任何时候，从自己的梦境购买卡牌。

en:
<margin-right=12em>Transform is a new mechanic introduced in Ascension: Darkness Unleashed™.  Cards that Transform represent beings and objects in the Ascension™ world undergoing dramatic changes.  These begin as one card and change into a different card when certain conditions are met.

Most of the cards that Transform do so based on Energize triggers.  If you would play a card with Transform after meeting its Energize threshold, you instead Transform the card into its new version and put that new card in your hand.  You do not generate any of the effects of the original card, nor is that card considered played.  The card remains in its Transformed state until the end of the game, when it resets to it's starting form.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>转化是《创升纪元：黑暗释放》™引入的新机制。会转化的卡牌代表创升纪元世界中经历剧变的存在与物件。它们先以一种形态出现，在满足特定条件时变为另一张牌。

大多数转化卡基于充能触发。若你在达到其充能阈值后本应打出带转化的卡牌，则改为将该牌转化为新版本并放入你的手牌。你不会产生原牌的任何效果，该牌也不视为已打出。卡牌保持转化状态直至对局结束，届时重置为初始形态。

en: <margin-right=12em>Dark Energy Shards are a new type of Treasure card introduced in Ascension: Darkness Unleashed™.  Dark Energy Shards represent the fragments from Erabus’s crystal prison that absorbed bits of his power before he broke free.  Dark Energy Shards work just like the Energy Shards in Ascension: Rise of Vigil™, except they also have a Fate effect that allows each player to banish a card in their discard pile when they enter the center row.
zh: <margin-right=12em>暗能碎片是《创升纪元：黑暗释放》™引入的新宝藏卡。它们代表厄拉布斯水晶牢笼在他挣脱前吸收其力量残片所成的碎片。暗能碎片的运作与《创升纪元：祈夜崛起》™中的能量碎片相同，但另有天命效果：当它们进入中央牌列时，每位玩家可以放逐其弃牌堆中的一张牌。

en: Many of the Monsters included in Ascension: Dawn of Champions™ have a faction. These Monsters represent corrupted denizens of New Vigil. They work exactly like standard Monsters, but are affected by Rally effects, Reputation Powers, and other specific card effects.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>《创升纪元：冠军黎明》™中的许多怪物具有派系。这些怪物代表新祈夜被腐化的住民。

它们与普通怪物完全相同，但会受到集结效果、名望能力及其他特定卡牌效果影响。

en: Continuing the popular multifaction mechanic from Ascension: Realms Unraveled™, multifaction Heroes make a reappearance in this set, along with the new multifaction Constructs. Multifaction cards function exactly the same as their normal counterparts, but count as every faction listed on their card.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>延续《创升纪元：领域解开》™广受欢迎的多派系机制，多派系英雄在本系列回归，并新增多派系神器。

多派系卡与普通对应卡运作完全相同，但视为其卡面上列出的每一个派系。

en: Chosen long ago by Logos to wield the Arhan god’s sight and wisdom, Dhartha has used it to aid the realms for generations. Small in stature, he proves that real power doesn’t come from standing over others, but by others kneeling before you.
zh: 很久以前被逻各斯选中，执掌亚哈神的目光与智慧，达尔塔世代以来以此助益诸界。他身材矮小，却证明真正的力量不来自凌驾他人，而来自他人跪拜于你。

en: Ascension: Dawn of Champions™ introduces a new card type called Champions. These cards allow you to play as powerful leaders from New Vigil. Each player begins the game with a randomly selected Champion in front of them. Each Champion has Reputation Powers that determine how a player can gain Reputation, and what rewards they will gain from it. Reputation Icon:
zh: 《创升纪元：冠军黎明》™引入名为冠军的新卡牌类型。这些卡让你扮演新祈夜的强大领袖。 每位玩家开局面前有一张随机选定的冠军。每位冠军具有名望能力，决定玩家如何获得名望，以及由此获得何种奖励。 名望图标：

en: In the beginning, when the realms were young and unblemished by eons of strife, elementals roamed freely throughout the lands of Vigil. As humanity emerged, the elementals receded, hiding away from those that would use them as resources for their endless fighting. Eventually, they fell into a deep slumber, becoming indistinguishable from the world around them. Now, as decades of turmoil have shaken New Vigil to its very core, the elementals have begun to awaken and reintroduce themselves to the world around them. The newly roused elementals roam the land, intent on discovering the unfamiliar world which they now find themselves a part of. The factions have begun to study and learn from the elements, unlocking powerful new enhancements and abilities. There are still other elementals that have no lessons besides the chaos they sow, neither good nor evil, but destructive all the same. Wildfires burn across the plains, storms assault the cities, and floods wipe away countless lifetimes of work. Malevolent forces of nature are not the only concern—amidst the turmoil, the mischievous gremlins have begun to grow in number, much to the annoyance of the rest of New Vigil’s inhabitants. All the while, Xeron continues to watch from the shadows, biding his time until another opportunity to strike against his enemies presents itself. Join the people of New Vigil as they attempt to discover the lessons of the elementals, and how to wield them, as they fight to protect their world against unseen forces.
zh: 太初之时，诸界尚幼、未遭纪元纷争玷污，元素生物在祈夜大地上自由游荡。人类兴起后，元素隐退，躲避那些要把它们当作无尽争斗资源的人。最终它们沉入深眠，与周遭世界难以分辨。 如今，数十年动荡撼动新祈夜至根基，元素开始苏醒并重现于世。新醒的元素漫游大地，意图认识这片它们如今所属的陌生世界。 各派系开始研习并向元素学习，解锁强大的新强化与能力。仍有另一些元素除散播混乱外别无所授——无关善恶，却同样具有破坏性。野火燃遍平原，风暴袭击城市，洪水冲刷无数世代的劳作。 恶意的自然之力并非唯一忧患——动荡之中，淘气的小妖数量开始增长，令新祈夜其余住民不胜其烦。与此同时，泽伦继续在阴影中注视，等待再次袭击敌人的时机。 加入新祈夜的人民，去发现元素的教诲以及如何运用它们，并在对抗看不见的力量时保卫世界。

en: When an Event is flipped from the center deck, it does not take up a center row slot. Instead, it is placed in the Event Zone above or below the center row. While one of these Events is in play, it will have an ongoing effect that will change how the game plays out. There can never be more than one Event active at once. If a new Event appears, replace the current event and put it in the Void. Events in Ascension: Gift of the Elements™ may also be acquired! These Events include a cost in their effect that may be paid by any player during their turn, at which point the Event will leave play and transform into a powerful Hero for that player's deck.
zh:
当事件从中央牌库翻出时，它不占用中央牌列栏位。相反，它被放入中央牌列上方或下方的事件区。当此类事件在场时，会有持续效果改变对局进程。同时至多只能有一个事件生效。若出现新事件，替换当前事件并将其置入虚空区。

《创升纪元：元素的馈赠》™中的事件也可被获取！这些事件在效果中含有费用，任意玩家可在其回合支付，此时事件离场并转化为强大英雄加入该玩家牌库。

en:
As the Heroes of Vigil struggle to fight back against the tides of undeath encroaching upon their lands, the source of the storm of souls has been discovered. The maelstrom comes from none other than Kythis himself. Once the gatekeeper of the afterlife, Kythis was freed from his duties in a nefarious bargain with Samael. When the Fallen One was defeated by the Godslayer, Kythis hatched a plan to ascend to the empty throne of Deofol.

 To distract enemies who might interfere with his plot, the rebel godling opened the gates of the underworld and unleashed the spirits of the damned. As the tempest of undeath swept over the land, Kythis sought to tap into the font of death itself – the Well of Souls. From within the Well, he drew forth the spirits of fallen Heroes and bound them to himself, encasing their essences in crystalline form. With these Soul Gems bolstering his powers, the former Gatekeeper seeks to bring the realm of Deofol under his sway.
zh:
当祈夜英雄奋力抵御侵蚀其土地的不死浪潮时，灵魂风暴的源头已被发现。风暴来自凯西斯本人。他曾是来世的守门人，却在与萨麦尔的邪恶交易中被解除职责。当堕落者被弑神者击败后，凯西斯密谋登上迪奥弗空悬的王座。

 为分散可能干涉其阴谋的敌人，叛神幼体打开冥界之门，放出被诅咒者的灵魂。当不死风暴席卷大地时，凯西斯试图汲取死亡本源——灵魂之井。他从井中拽出陨落英雄的灵魂，将其束缚于己，把本质封入水晶形态。借这些灵魂宝石增强力量，前守门人试图将迪奥弗置于其掌控之下。

en:
<margin-right=12em>In Storm of Souls, all Trophy Monsters provided a single effect and were then banished once used. In Immortal Heroes, some Trophy Monsters have lasting effects, indicated by the word “Ongoing.” Just like normal Trophy Monsters, these Monsters provide their Honor reward immediately when defeated and are then placed face up in front of you. They continue to provide their effect for as long as they remain in play under your control. 

<i>Example: Kythis, Rebel Godling says “Ongoing Trophy: Once per turn, gain a Soul Gem.” As long as a player has Kythis as a Trophy, he or she can use it to gain a Soul Gem once each turn.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>在灵魂风暴中，所有战利品怪物提供单一效果，使用后即被放逐。在不朽英雄中，部分战利品怪物具有持续效果，以“持续”一词标明。与普通战利品怪物一样，这些怪物被击败时立即提供荣誉奖励，然后正面朝上放在你面前。只要它们仍在你控制下留在战场，就会持续提供其效果。

<i>示例：凯西斯·反叛神子写着「持续战利品：每回合一次，获得灵魂宝石。」只要玩家以凯西斯为战利品，每回合都可用它获得一枚灵魂宝石。

en:
<margin-right=12em>Soul Gems are a new type of card introduced in Immortal Heroes. Soul Gems represent the spirits of heroes who fought against Samael in the Great War who were trapped by Kythis when he took control of the Well of Souls. Each Soul Gem shares the art and effect of Heroes from previous Ascension sets, though they are not Hero cards themselves. 

Soul Gems are not shuffled into the center deck at the beginning of the game. Instead, they are shuffled together and set aside face down with the Always Available cards. When a card effect tells a player to gain a Soul Gem, that player takes the top card of the Soul Gem deck and places it face up in front of him or her. That player may play that Soul Gem to gain its effect at any time during that turn. At the end of a player’s turn, all Soul Gems he or she controls are banished.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>灵魂宝石是不朽英雄引入的新卡牌类型。它们代表在大战中对抗萨麦尔、却在凯西斯掌控灵魂之井时被困住的英雄之灵。每枚灵魂宝石共享先前创升纪元系列中英雄的插画与效果，但它们本身不是英雄卡。

灵魂宝石不会在对局开始时洗入中央牌库。相反，它们洗在一起，正面朝下与始终可用卡放在一旁。当卡牌效果让玩家获得灵魂宝石时，该玩家取灵魂宝石牌库顶牌，正面朝上放在自己面前。该玩家可在本回合任何时候打出该灵魂宝石以获得其效果。在玩家回合结束时，其控制的所有灵魂宝石都被放逐。

en:
For as long as anyone can remember, Adayu has been a benevolent protector of the five realms. Able to alter reality with nothing more than a thought, he has saved Vigil countless times over, but now he may be its undoing.

The centuries of pain and struggle have begun to take their toll on Adayu’s mind. What will happen to Vigil if a being with the power to change reality loses his understanding of what that means? The realms must all unite to save Adayu, and existence itself, from being lost to madness.

As Adayu’s insanity takes its hold, the realms have begun to collide and join with one another. To combat this threat, new alliances between factions have formed and powerful champions are at your disposal to battle the spreading chaos.

Horrors from Adayu's nightmares pillage the land. Vigil's foundations shake as they are unmade and remade in a twisted reflection. Can Adayu be restored before there is nothing left to save? It’s up to you.
zh:
自人们记事以来，阿达尤一直是五界的仁慈守护者。仅凭一念便可改写现实，他无数次拯救祈夜——但如今也可能成为其毁灭。

数世纪的痛苦与挣扎开始侵蚀阿达尤的心智。若一个能改变现实的存在失去了对「现实」的理解，祈夜会怎样？诸界必须团结，拯救阿达尤与存在本身，以免沉沦于疯狂。

随着阿达尤的疯狂蔓延，诸界开始碰撞并彼此融合。为对抗此威胁，派系间结成新同盟，强大冠军任你调遣，以抗扩散的混乱。

阿达尤梦魇中的恐怖蹂躏大地。祈夜的根基在扭曲映象中被拆解又重塑。能否在一无所剩之前恢复阿达尤？取决于你。

en: Some cards in Ascension: Realms Unraveled™ have the Transform ability. Each card transforms based upon a condition specific to that particular card. When the condition is met, the original card is replaced with the Transformed version. You do not generate any of the effects of the original card, nor is that card considered played. The card remains in its transformed state until the end of the game.
zh: <margin-right=12em>《创升纪元：领域解开》™中的部分卡牌具有转化能力。每张牌依据该牌特有的条件转化。条件满足时，原牌被转化为版本替换。你不会产生原牌的任何效果，该牌也不视为已打出。卡牌保持转化状态直至对局结束。

en: Ascension: Realms Unraveled™ introduces a new mechanic called Multi-Unite. Cards with Multi-Unite have additional effects that occur if you play them in the same turn as other Heroes that share the same faction. You gain the bonus effects listed under the Multi-Unite ability for each other Hero you play or have played that shares a faction with the Hero with Multi-Unite. The order in which you play the Heroes does not matter, since Multi-Unite counts Heroes played before or after the card. Example: Everbloom Clique is a Lifebound Hero with “Multi-Unite: Gain .” If you played a Lifebound Hero before Everbloom Clique, and then another afterwards, you would gain a total of from the Multi-Unite ability.
zh: 《创升纪元：领域解开》™引入新机制：多重联合。带有多重联合的卡牌，若你在同一回合打出与其同派系的其他英雄，会产生额外效果。你每打出（或已打出）一张与带多重联合的英雄同派系的其他英雄，便获得多重联合下列出的加成。 打出英雄的顺序无关紧要，因为多重联合会计入该牌之前或之后打出的英雄。 示例：永绽党羽是命约英雄，写着「多重联合：获得 。」若你在永绽党羽之前打出一张命约英雄，之后又打出另一张，则你从多重联合一共获得 。

en: Cards in Ascension: Realms Unraveled™ can belong to more than one faction. Multifaction cards are played just like any other cards except they have multiple factions. This allows them to satisfy the requirements for different Multi-Unite abilities or Transform conditions based on factions. For example, Disciple of Oziah can transform if you have played another Enlightened Hero this turn, and Disciple of Euloth can transform if you have played a Mechana Hero. If you play Canon Templar, you can transform both Disciples, because it is both an Enlightened and Mechana Hero and satisfies the requirements of both.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>《创升纪元：领域解开》™中的卡牌可属于多个派系。多派系卡与其他卡一样打出，只是具有多个派系。这使它们能满足不同多重联合能力或基于派系的转化条件。

例如，奥齐亚门徒可在你本回合已打出另一张圣贤英雄时转化，而欧洛斯门徒可在你已打出机械英雄时转化。若你打出教典圣殿武士，则可转化两位门徒，因为它同时是圣贤与机械英雄，满足二者条件。

en:
<margin-right=12em>Energy <sprite=96> is a new type of resource in Rise of Vigil.  Unlike Runes or Power, Energy is not spent.  Some cards have Energize abilities which turn on when you reach a certain Energy threshold.  The Energize text on a Hero, Construct, or Monster reward is active if you have gained Energy equal to or greater than its Energize number that turn.

<i>Example: Darkwalker says “Gain <sprite=2>. <color=#005778ff>Energize <sprite=97>:</color> You may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.”

Playing Darkwalker will always give you 2 Power.  If you have gained 1 or more Energy during your turn before you play Darkwalker, you will also be able to banish a card from your hand or discard pile.  If you have 2 copies of Darkwalker, you can use both of their Energize powers even if you have gained only 1 Energy that turn, since Energy is a threshold resource and not spent.
zh:
<margin-right=12em>能量 <sprite=96> 是祈夜崛起的新资源。与符文或战力不同，能量不会被花费。部分卡牌具有充能异能：当你达到一定能量阈值时开启。英雄、神器或怪物奖励上的充能文字，在你本回合已获得的能量达到或超过其充能数字时生效。

<i>示例：暗行者写着「获得 <sprite=2>。<color=#005778ff>充能 <sprite=97>：</color>你可以放逐手牌或弃牌堆中的一张牌。」

打出暗行者总会给你2点战力。若你在打出暗行者之前本回合已获得1点或更多能量，你还可以放逐手牌或弃牌堆中的一张牌。若你有2张暗行者，即使本回合只获得1点能量，也可以使用二者的充能能力，因为能量是阈值资源而非被花费。

en: My divinations relate a frightful tale- I have seen cosmic events of the darkest portent. There lately came to the yawning gate of death a divine spirit, wrathful and red, not to be mistaken for a mortal will. The Gatekeeper knelt and, with two hands, plucked it from the stream of souls, brushing stars from the pulsating force like so many burrs. "This soul is familiar," said the Gatekeeper. Then was heard a viper's voice, as if spoken from five mouths at once: It is because I created you. You must release me. "Yet, I am bound to send you on your way," the Gatekeeper replied. "You wore a mortal skin. You must suffer a mortal fate." No, Kythis. You are bound no longer. Forbear my fate, Gatekeeper, and I shall absolve you of yours. It is still within my power. Thus, Samael the Fallen was spared exile to Deofol—at the cost of leaving death's riverbank forever unwatched, the gate untended, and all wills condemned to purgatory. Now, the flames of war again decorate the horizon. Terror grips the frontier, so recently resettled, only to be submerged anew in the blood of mortals. With the Gatekeeper gone, the souls torn from the bodies of Vigil's defenders will know no respite unless all is set right. Let a call echo across all of Vigil. The bickering that came in war's wake must end. A Godslayer must take up arms a second time. The Fallen has returned.
zh: 我的占卜述说一个骇人故事——我看见最黑暗凶兆的宇宙事件。近日，一道神圣之灵来到死亡的裂口之门：暴怒而赤红，绝非凡人之志。守门人跪下，双手将它从灵魂之流中捞起，像摘刺一般拂去搏动之力上的星辰。 「此魂似曾相识，」守门人说。随后响起如五口齐发的蝰蛇之声：因为是我创造了你。你必须放我自由。 「可我仍须送你上路，」守门人答道。「你曾披凡人皮囊。你须承受凡人的命运。」 不，凯西斯。你已不再受缚。宽恕我的命运吧，守门人，我将免除你的。这仍在我力量之内。 于是堕落者萨麦尔免于放逐迪奥弗——代价是死亡河岸从此无人看守，门户无人值守，一切意志都被判入炼狱。 如今战火再次装点地平线。恐怖攫住刚被重新定居的边疆，只为再次淹没在凡人的鲜血中。守门人已去，从祈夜守御者身上撕下的灵魂将永无安息，除非一切被拨乱反正。 让呼声响彻整座祈夜。战后的争执必须结束。弑神者必须第二次拿起武器。 堕落者已经归来。

en: <margin-right=16em>Event cards represent global effects that change the power structure of the world. When an Event flips from the Portal Deck, it is put into the Event Zone instead of the center row. The card is then replaced in the Center Row as normal.  There may be only one Event in the Event Zone at any given time. While an Event is there it is considered the current Event. Events alter the rules of the game, and the current Event’s game text applies to every player.
zh: <margin-right=16em>事件卡代表改变世界权力结构的全局效果。当事件从传送门牌库翻出时，它进入事件区而非中央牌列。中央牌列会照常补牌。事件区在任何时候至多只能有一张事件。当事件位于该处时，视为当前事件。事件改变对局规则，当前事件的规则文字对每位玩家生效。

en:
For centuries, the valley of Alosya has remained hidden from the rest of Vigil. Guarded by treacherous mountains, the valley cradled an ancient civilization that rose and fell, cut off entirely from the outside world. In the absence of the gods, the people of Alosya worshipped the forces that ruled the world around them— life and death. They built two temples that focused and harnessed those energies, and revered the journey between the two.

After many years, the society became corrupted by its own success, and they decided to build a third temple, the Temple of Immortality. Instead of maintaining a balance, this new vessel would allow them to wield control of the forces as they saw fit.

The impassible terrain that once protected the valley was pierced by the formation of New Vigil. Ill-fated adventurers have ventured into the valley for decades, but none of them had escaped its dangers until now. Endbringer Jora has led a successful Void expedition into the valley, returning with tales of terrifying beasts and mysterious ruins.

Now, the forces of New Vigil venture into the valley, hoping to uncover a powerful weapon in their battle against Xeron. What they don't know is that the foes and temptation awaiting them in Alosya may pose an even greater threat.

The imbalance of the temples corrupted the valley, turning the Alosyans on each other and mutating the surrounding jungle's inhabitants into unimaginable monsters. With its return to primal order, the Temples became dormant.
zh:
数世纪以来，阿洛西亚山谷对祈夜其余地区隐而不现。险峻群山守护着山谷，孕育出与外界完全隔绝、兴衰自生的古老文明。在神明缺席时，阿洛西亚人敬拜统治周遭世界的力量——生与死。他们建造两座神殿聚焦并驾驭这些能量，并尊崇二者之间的旅程。

多年之后，社会因自身成功而腐化，他们决定建造第三座神殿：不朽神殿。新容器不再维持平衡，而是让他们随心所欲掌控这些力量。

曾保护山谷的绝境，因新祈夜的形成而被打通。数十年来倒霉的冒险者闯入山谷，却无人逃脱其危险——直到现在。终焉使者乔拉率领一次成功的虚空远征进入山谷，带回可怖野兽与神秘遗迹的传说。

如今，新祈夜的势力进入山谷，希望在对抗泽伦的战争中找到强大武器。他们不知道，阿洛西亚等待他们的敌手与诱惑可能构成更大威胁。

神殿失衡腐化山谷，令阿洛西亚人自相残杀，并使周遭丛林住民异变为难以想象的怪物。随着回归原始秩序，神殿陷入沉眠。

en: In Ascension: Valley of the Ancients™, players compete with one another to maintain control over powerful Temple cards. There are three different Temples that players can control— the Temple of Life, the Temple of Death and the ultimate Temple of Immortality.
zh: 在《创升纪元：上古山谷》™中，玩家彼此竞争以维持对强大神殿卡的控制。玩家可控制三座不同神殿——生命神殿、死亡神殿，以及终极的不朽神殿。

en:
One of the new features in Ascension X: War of Shadows™ are Light and Dark cards – whose powers grow stronger depending on whether the Light or Dark is better represented in the center row. A <sprite=143> on the upper right hand corner of a card represents that the card is a Light card, while a <sprite=142> on the upper right hand corner of a card represents that the card is a Dark card.

If there are more <sprite=143> cards in the center row than <sprite=142> cards, then it is Day. Day bonuses on cards will be active during this time.

If there are more <sprite=142> cards in the center row than <sprite=143> cards, then it is Night. Night bonuses on cards will be active during this time.

If there are the same amount of <sprite=143> cards and <sprite=142> cards in the center row, then it is neither Day or Night. No Day or Night bonuses on cards will be active during this time.
zh:
《创升纪元 X：暗影之战》™的新内容之一是光暗卡——其力量会随中央牌列中光或暗何者更占优势而增强。卡牌右上角的 <sprite=143> 表示光卡，<sprite=142> 表示暗卡。

若中央牌列中 <sprite=143> 卡多于 <sprite=142> 卡，则为昼。此时卡牌上的昼间加成生效。

若中央牌列中 <sprite=142> 卡多于 <sprite=143> 卡，则为夜。此时卡牌上的夜间加成生效。

若中央牌列中 <sprite=143> 与 <sprite=142> 数量相同，则既非昼也非夜。此时卡牌上的昼/夜加成均不生效。

en:
* New dual-cost Heroes and Constructs require players to use both resources to acquire them, but have incredible power!
*As the balance between Light and Dark shifts, cards gain additional powers depending on whether it is Night or Day.
zh:
* 新的双费英雄与神器需要玩家同时使用两种资源才能获取，但拥有惊人的力量！
* 随着光暗平衡推移，卡牌会依当前为夜或昼获得额外能力。

en:
Delirium brings players back into the Dreamscape, facing a twisted new reality.

Insight and Dreamborn cards are back, but with new powers to unlock with them.

Win Fate Auctions, Recur hero effects, and roll the amazing Delirium Die with your Insight to gain an edge against the other players!

Includes 49 unique new cards.
zh:
谵妄将玩家带回梦境，面对扭曲的新现实。

洞察与梦生卡回归，并带来新的可解锁力量。

赢得天命拍卖、复发英雄效果，并用洞察掷出神奇的谵妄骰，抢占对其他玩家的优势！

包含49张独特新卡。

en:
Return to the world of Vigil as the Muses of Malevolence rise to bring ruin. Legendary Heroes from Ascension’s past have returned to guide you, granting their power to those who prove worthy.

Each card you acquire or defeat grants Renown with its factions, advancing you on the Legendary Track. As your Renown grows, unlock powerful Boons from Legendary Characters and, at the pinnacle of a faction’s track, gain Legendry status with the power to acquire or defeat one card from that faction for free each turn.

Includes 86 unique new cards.
zh:
重返祈夜世界：恶意缪斯崛起，欲带来毁灭。创升纪元往昔的传奇英雄归来指引你，将力量授予证明自己配得上的人。

你获取或击败的每张牌都会为其派系带来声望，推动你在传奇轨道上前进。随着声望增长，解锁传奇角色的强大恩赐；在某派系轨道顶点时，获得传奇地位，每回合可免费获取或击败一张该派系卡牌。

包含86张独特新卡。

en:
Dark forces have taken over the Dreamscape. Team up with Pasythea, collect her legendary weapons, and return order to her world!

Use the Insight resources and Dreamborn cards to save the Dreamscape. Bind Monsters to your deck and use them in battle! Transform cards to incredible heroes and Constructs and acquire Pasythea! Pair Deliverance with Dreamscape and Delirium for an even more exciting game!

Includes 51 unique
new cards.
zh:
黑暗势力已占据梦境。与帕西提亚并肩，收集她的传奇武器，令其世界恢复秩序！

运用洞察资源与梦生卡拯救梦境。将怪物束缚进你的牌库并用于战斗！将卡牌转化为惊人的英雄与神器，并获取帕西提亚！把救赎与梦境、谵妄搭配，对局更加精彩！

包含51张独特
新卡。

en: When playing with Ascension: Deliverance™, each player starts with an 11th starting card, the Dreamseeker.
zh: <margin-right=12em>使用《创升纪元：救赎》™时，每位玩家开局多一张第11张起始卡：寻梦者。

en: <margin-right=12em>When you defeat a Monster with Infest, you may choose a player and put that Monster into their discard pile instead of the void. When a Monster is drawn, it has no effect on its own, so this is a great way to mess up your opponent’s draws. Be careful though, there are a few cards in Ascension: Gift of the Elements™ that allow players to benefit from having Monsters in their deck.
zh: <margin-right=12em>当你击败带有感染的怪物时，你可以选择一名玩家，将该怪物放入其弃牌堆而非虚空区。怪物被抽到时本身没有效果，因此这是破坏对手抽牌的好方法。但请小心：《创升纪元：元素的馈赠》™中有少量卡牌能让玩家从牌库中有怪物中获益。

en:
Life Keystone (<sprite=161>): When you gain a <sprite=161>, you may spend it to take one of the following actions:

•<indent=1em>Gain control of the Temple of Life. If another player already controls it, you may take it from them.
</indent>
•<indent=1em>If you already control the Temple of Life, gain control of the Temple of Immortality and gain <sprite=34>.
</indent>
•<indent=1em>If you already control the Temple of Death and the Temple of Immortality, gain <sprite=34>.
zh:
生命钥石（<sprite=161>）：当你获得 <sprite=161> 时，可以花费它执行下列行动之一：
•<indent=1em>夺取生命神殿的控制。若另一名玩家已控制它，你可以从其手中夺走。</indent>
•<indent=1em>若你已控制生命神殿，夺取不朽神殿的控制并获得 <sprite=34>。</indent>
•<indent=1em>若你已控制死亡神殿与不朽神殿，获得 <sprite=34>。</indent>

en:
Death Keystone (<sprite=162>) : When you gain a <sprite=162>, you may spend it to take one of the following actions:

•<indent=1em>Gain control of the Temple of Death. If another player already controls it, you may take it from them.</indent>
•<indent=1em>If you already control the Temple of Death, gain control of the Temple of Immortality and you may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.
</indent>
•<indent=1em>If you already control the Temple of Death and the Temple of Immortality, you may banish a card from your hand or discard pile.
zh:
死亡钥石（<sprite=162>）：当你获得 <sprite=162> 时，可以花费它执行下列行动之一：
•<indent=1em>夺取死亡神殿的控制。若另一名玩家已控制它，你可以从其手中夺走。</indent>
•<indent=1em>若你已控制死亡神殿，夺取不朽神殿的控制，并且你可以放逐手牌或弃牌堆中的一张牌。</indent>
•<indent=1em>若你已控制死亡神殿与不朽神殿，你可以放逐手牌或弃牌堆中的一张牌。</indent>

en: <margin-right=12em>Dual Cost cards are a new type of card in Ascension X: War of Shadows™. Dual Cost cards require players to spend both Runes and Power to acquire them. Both the Rune and Power costs  listed on Dual Cost cards need to be paid in order to acquire them.
zh: <margin-right=12em>双费卡是《创升纪元 X：暗影之战》™的新卡牌类型。双费卡要求玩家同时花费符文与战力才能获取。符文与战力两种费用都会印在卡面上。
